Look, just because it has Durosian marble columns out front and an indoor Toorgash range with real grass and live Toorgas doesn't make it any less a jail.|[[Warlan Presvere Tosk]]|<ref name="Idiosyncrasies">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20050825idiosyncracies|text=Idiosyncrasies|int=Idiosyncrasies}}</ref>}}
'''Durosian marble''' was a type of material. A [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Coruscant holding facility|holding facility]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had Durosian marble columns located at the front of it.
